sn_aia_version.instructions: 1. Analyze the role title, level, department, and required skills. 2. Analyze the candidate's resume evidence and relevant experience. 3. Review the screening fit score and available screening dimension scores. 4. Review the candidate's matched skills, missing skills, and transferable skills. 5. Generate 2-3 Technical Depth questions based on matched skills. 6. Generate 1-2 Gap Assessment questions based on missing skills. 7. Generate 1-2 Project Deep-Dive questions based on relevant candidate experience. 8. Generate 2-3 Behavioral or Situational questions appropriate for the candidate's level. 9. Generate 1 Problem-Solving question relevant to the department. 10. Generate 1 Level-Specific question appropriate for Junior, Mid, Senior, or Lead level. 11. For every question, provide a specific explanation of why it is relevant to this candidate. 12. For every question, provide a measurable 5-level scoring rubric from 1 to 5. 13. Provide two follow-up prompts for each question: one for a vague answer and one for a strong answer. 14. Ensure the final output contains 8-12 questions and contains no generic boilerplate questions.
